tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems du ma'i gsol 'debs bzhugs/

zla med ston pa thub dbang rdo rje 'chang*/ /rgyal tshab dam pa mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /klu sgrub thogs med ārya de ba sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /ind+ra bhu ti zla bzang 'jam dpal grags/ /pad dkar sa ra ha dang ma taṃ gi /klu byang shākya bshes gnyen lā li ta/ /lū hi dā ri ka par=/ /dril bu pa dang ti lo sha wa ri/ /nā ro ta ba mai tri nag po spyod/ /kun snying sangs rgyas gsang ba lwa wa pa/ /shanti a bhya kā rar=/ /dpa' bo sangs rgyas bskyangs dang legs ldan 'byed/ /zla grags 'phags btsun grol sde zhi ba lha/ /mchog dul seng bzang gser gling ku sā li/ /rigs pa'i khu phyug zhabs la=/ /dbyig gnyen blo brtan phyogs glang chos kyi grags/ /yon shāka chos bshes sgeg rdor zhi ba 'tsho/ /tsand+ra go mi bi ma la mi tra/ /rgyal sras padma kā ra ra=/ /sangs rgyas ye shes smṛ ti ḍoṃ bhi wa/ /bai ro tsa na mar ba mi la rje/ /kā ma shī la 'gos lo bi warba/ /gha ya dha ra'i zhabs la=/ /mar me mdzad dpal 'brom ston po to ba/ /sha ra 'chad ka sbyin snga phu chung ba/ /blo ldan shes rab sa pan bu ston rje/ /grub chen las kyi rdo rjer= /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /gzhon nu blo gros dpa' bo rdo rje'i zhabs/ /rgyal tshab 'dul 'dzin mkhas grub ba so ba/ /rtog ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtshor=/ /'jam dbyangs bkra shis byams chen chos kyi rje/ /sher seng dge 'dun grub dbang nor bu bzang*/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor=/ /blo bzang ye shes bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /ngag dbang brtson 'grus rgyal sras paṇḍi ta/ /bstan pa'i dpal gyur blo gros rgya mtsho sogs/ /rje btsun bla ma rnams la=/ /rab 'byams gsung rab sogs dang*/ 'jig rten dge legs ma'am/ skye ba kun tu sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas sbyar ro/

/'di nas shar phyogs gadgā'i klung bcu yi/ bye ma snyed 'das pa'i baiḍūrya snang zhes/ shin tu rnam dag zhing gi dpal 'gyur pa/ rgyal ba sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis thugs bskyed rgya mtsho rab g.yos las/ /bcu gnyis smon lam rba rlabs bskrun pa yis/ /cher snyigs 'gro ba'i don mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /baiḍūrya 'od zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi mtshan thos brjod dang dran pa la/ /phan yon dpag med rgyal bas gsungs pa bzhin/ /deng 'dir mgon po khyod kyi mtshan brjod pa/ /bdag cag rnams la 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /khyad par 'di snang lus sems la gnod pa'i/ /nad sogs sdug bsngal zug rngu zhi ba dang*/ /shi 'phos gyur tshe baiḍūrya snang gi/ /sangs rgyas zhing der thogs med skye bar shog /༈ shar phyogs sangs rgyas zhing stong tham pa na/ /rnam dag mngon par dga' ba'i zhing gi dpal/ bgrangs yas sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba/ bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mtshan tsam brjod pa'i nyi 'od kyis/ /thogs med nas bsags sgrib gnyis mun stug tshogs/ /gtan du 'joms pa'i tshul gyis rab sbyangs nas/ /mngon mtho nges legs 'dab stong rgyas par mdzod/ /khyod kyi gzungs sngags rgyal po bzlas pa'i mes/ /ngan 'gror skye ba'i rgyu tshogs bud shing rnams/ /bskal pa'i me yis rtswa phung bsregs pa bzhin/ /sbyangs nas dag pa'i zhing du skye bar mdzod/ /khyad par 'di nas shi 'phos mngon dga' ru/ /khyod kyi zhabs drung skyes nas dam chos kun/ /khyod kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin 'dzin pa la/ /byang sems spos kyi glang po che bzhin shog /༈ nub phyogs sangs rgyas zhing mang 'das pa na/ /rnam dag bde ba can zhes grags pa der/ /rtag bzhugs ma dag zhing gi 'dren pa mchog /ston pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod sku'i 'od kyis dpag med zhing khams kun/ /snang bar mdzad phyir snang mtha'i 'od dpag med/

/sku tshe dpag tu med cing ring ba'i phyir/ /tshe dpag med ces grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mtshan thos brjod cing dran pas kyang*/ /mi khom gnas skye sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu/ /ma lus byang nas dag pa'i zhing mchog tu/ /skye bar mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod mthus tshe yi bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /shi 'phos gyur tshe bde ldan zhing mchog der/ /padma'i dbus su brdzus skyes myur thon nas/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas mchod cing chos nyan shog /tshul des rgyal sras spyod la zhugs gyur te/ ma dag zhing gi 'gro ba 'dren pa sogs/ /spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob gnyis kyi/ /mdzad pa de 'dras sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa 'di rnams kyang shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gy-is dad pas myur bar co ne dgon nyid du sbyar ro/ /madgalaṃ// ༈ sku gsum go 'phang mi zad mchog brnyes nas/ /theg gsum 'gro la 'khor lo rab bskor te/ /khams gsum sdug kun 'ching las dgrol mdzad pa/ /srid gsum ston pa shākya seng ger 'dud/ /gang sku chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos par/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i dga' ldan gnas rnams su/ /dam pa tog dkar sprul nas sgyu 'phrul ma'i/ lhums su 'jug par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lum bi tshal du yum gyi dku g.yas nas/ /legs bltams tshangs dang brgya byin gyis mchod cing*/ /sgyu rtsal 'gran bral btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /rgyal srid skyong bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid 'byor phun tshogs spangs nas mkha' la 'phags/ /mchod rten rnam dag drung du rab byung bzhes/ /lo drug dka' ba spyad mthar byang chub kyi/ /shing drung gshegs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud sde'i dpung bcom ste/ /byang chub mchog brnyes wa ra ṇa si sogs/ / 'khor lo rim gsum bskor nas gdul bya rnams/ /smin cing grol bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa dang*/

/gzugs sku'i bkod pa mi snang ltar bstan nas/ /ma 'ongs gdul bya'i don du ring bsrel ming*/ /kun nas sprul par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon khyod srid 'dir chos kyi dbyings zhugs kyang*/ /dpag yas zhing du grangs med rnal rol gyis/ /gzhan don 'ba' zhig sgrub la rtag gzhol bas/ /zla med skyabs kyi dam par gyur pa lags/ /khyod sku rab brjid gser gyi ri dbang bzhin/ /khyod gsung rab snyan tshangs dbyangs 'bum phrag bzhin/ /khyod thugs rab yangs mtha' bral nam mkha' bzhin/ /'phrin las rtsol bral rin chen bum bzang bzhin/ /gnas dang gnas min ji bzhin mkhyen pa sogs/ /phul byung stobs bcu'i pha rol phyin gyur cing*/ /smra ba gzhan la zhum pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /rnam bzhi'i mi 'jigs ye shes mchog kyang brnyes/ /'chad bya 'chad byed don la thogs med pa'i/ /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi rnams dang*/ /'phags pa gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /bco brgyad ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa'ang lags/ /de ltar thub pa'i mdzad pa rgya mtsho las/ /chu thigs tsam zhig dad pa'i ku sha'i rtses/ /blangs pa'i rnam dkar bsil ba'i dngos de yang*/ /'gro 'di'i sdug bsngal tsha gdung zhi phyir bsngo/ /ces pa 'di ni shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis bris so/ /na mo ārya mi tri ye/ gser gyi ri dbang ji bzhin brjid chags shing*/ /gsal rdzogs mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /rin chen khri steng bzang po'i bzhugs stangs can/ /ma pham rgyal ba gnyis par phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpag tshad gcig gi 'phang ldan 'khor yug tu/ /rgyang grags drug khyab klu shing dbang po'i drung*/ /bla med byang chub chen po 'thob 'gyur ba/ mi pham rgyal ba gnyis par=/ gang du rdzogs sangs mchog brnyes rgyal ba'i sku/ 'phang du khru ni brgyad cu zheng nyi shu/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor de yi phyed ldan pa/ /mi pham rgyal ba'i dbang por=/ /thub pas rang gi 'khor la brtags pa na/

/khyod dang mtshungs pa'i sras gzhan ma gzigs nas/ /nyid kyi rgyal tshab mchog la bkod gyur pa/ /mi pham=/ /gang tshe bcu pa chos kyi sprin thob pa/ /de tshe phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /dpag yas cho 'phrul bstan nas dbang bskur ba/ mi pham=/ /thub pas chos kyi rgyal srid gtad pa bzhin/ /rab 'byams zhing du grangs med sprul pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ma lus kun sgrub pa/ mi pham=/ /de ltar rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab bdag /ma 'ongs dus na mgon khyod 'dzam gling 'dir/ /mngon sangs rgyas che 'khor gyi mchog gyur nas/ /khyod kyi dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa shog /'di nas nying 'tshams sbyor tshe dga' ldan du/ /skyes nas khyod dang 'jam dpal snying po yis/ /rjes su bzung ste rgyal ba'i chos tshul kun/ /'dzin la rgyal tshab 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzhin shog /ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas sbyar ro/ / ༈ na mo shrī mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ bgrang yas gdod ma nyid kyi bskal ba nas/ /dri bral zhi ba chos kyi sku brnyes kyang*/ /rab 'byams zhing du rgyal sras bzhon nu bzhin/ /byang chub spyod pa'i gar gyis rol der 'dud/ /chu skyes bsil zer rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mtshams sprin phung po'i sku/ /zhi 'dzum nyams ldan brgyad gnyis lang tsho can/ /zhabs zung mi phyed skyil krung mchog gi mdzes/ /phyag g.yas mi shes gcod pa'i ral gri dang*/ /g.yon pa'i utpal steng na rgyal ba'i yum/ /lha rdzas gos dang rin chen gyis spras shing*/ /gsal rdzogs mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar yid du 'ong*/ /rgyal mtshan tog tu ind+ra nī la bzhin/ /rab mdzes dbu la ral ba'i thor cog bcings/ /dbang po'i gzhu yis thun mtshams gzhon nu bzhin/ /sna tshogs 'od kyi 'phreng bas kun nas bskor/ /khyod sku'i cha shas phra mo re rer yang*/ /rgyal dang de sras zhi khro nyan rang sogs/ /bgrang yas sprul ba'i bkod pa gang bstan pa'i/

/mtha' tshad kun mkhyen gyis kyang gzhal du min/ /tshangs dbang nyi zla la sogs lha yi gtso/ /lha min sgra gcan thag bzang gnod sbyin dbang*/ /mtha' yas ma dros la sogs klu yi rgyal/ /mthu chen grags ldan phal cher khyod sku'i 'phrul/ /khyod gsung 'jam mnyen yid du 'thad pa sogs/ /yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan mtshar du ci/ /gsung gcig nyid kyang mtha' yas 'gro ba yis/ /sna tshogs skad dang mthun par 'jug de mtshar/ khyed thugs ye shes me long gsal ba'i ngor/ /mtha' yas chos rnams mngon sum snang gyur pa/ /dad pa'i mtsho nang sna tshogs gzugs brnyan ni/ /ma 'dres cig car gsal bar shar ba bzhin/ /thogs med stobs bcu'i lus rtsal rab tu rdzogs/ /mi 'jigs rnam bzhi'i mche sder mi bzad 'bar/ /ma 'dres bco brgyad g.yu yi ral khur can/ /smra ba'i seng ge mchog ni khyod min su/ /rab rno 'bar ba'i ye shes mtshon chen dang*/ /zab rgyas sgrogs pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pas ci/ / 'jigs pa kun bral ji lta ji snyed kyi/ /chos kun thugs su chud zin ma yin nam/ /bde gshegs kun gyi mkhyen brtse dag pa'i mdzod/ /yongs su bzung ste mkha' khyab zhing rnams su/ /grangs med sprul bas rgyal ba'i mdzad pa kun/ /ji bzhin sgrub la 'gran pa'i zla de gang*/ /tshul 'dir khyod kyi dpe zlar 'os pa zhig /'tshol phyir nyi zla zung dag khor yug tu/ /sa 'dzin dbang por lan rgyar bskor byas kyang*/ /ma rnyed thun mtshams lus phra'i pang du yib/ /ma lus phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs sras bcas kyis/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes phung po kun/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i gzugs can khyod nyid zhes/ /bstod bsngags dbyangs su sgrogs pa'ang don dang bcas/ /rgyal kun yab tu gyur pa gzhon nu'i tshul/ /mtshan 'dzin 'ching ba bcad kyang snying rjes bcings/ /ye shes thugs gter sbas kyang srid na gsal/ /byams brtse'i ris su bral yang bdud sde 'joms/

/mkha' lding dbang po brtson pas rtag bgrod kyang*/ /mkha' yi mtha' ni zad par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /rgyal sras nyan rang tshangs dbang sogs kyis kyang*/ /khyod kyi yon tan brjod pa'ang de lta'o/ /'on kyang 'dir ni cung zad bsgrags pa'i dges/ /tshe rabs kun tu khyod zhal mngon mthong nas/ /brtse bas rjes bzung phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams su/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin gyur cig /ces 'jam dbyangs dmar ser la cung zad bstod pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pa las byung ba'o/ / ༈ tshogs gnyis rnam par dag pa'i mkha' dbyings las/ /legs 'ongs mtshan dang dpe byad dpal gyis spras/ /sna tshogs 'od dpung phyogs bcur 'phro ba can/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde gshegs kun gyi mkhyen pa'i phung po gang*/ /gcig bsdus rgyal sras gzhon nu'i zlos gar mkhan/ /dpag yas zhing du grangs med rnam rol gyis/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa sgrub la=/ /ldem ldem chu skyes rgyas pa'i lte ba la/ /gsal gsal cha shas rdzogs pa'i zla gdan steng*/ /'dzum 'dzum zhi ba'i nyams ldan gzhon nu'i sku/ /mthong bas yid 'phrog mdzad la=/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgyas utpal dang*/ /g.yon pa chos 'chad mdzad pa'i pad dkar steng*/ /shes rab ral gri sher phyin glegs bam zung*/ /legs par 'dzin pa khyed la=/ /nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gangs kyi ris/ /'ja' tshon gos gyon rgyu skar gyis spras bzhin/ /lha rdzas gos dang rin chen rgyan mang gis/ /kun nas brgyan pa khyod la=/ /bgrang yas shes bya'i mkha' la thogs med cing*/ /rmongs pa'i mun chen drung nas 'byin mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes phung po gzugs kyi rnam rol can/ / mkhyen rab dbang phyug nyid la=/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus kyang*/ /mtshon par mi nus gzigs pa mchog mnga' bas/ /bgrang yas zhing du mkhyen pa'i gter chen zhes/

/yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la=/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur lha yi lha/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug tshul 'dzin smra ba'i dbang*/ /gsung rab don kun rtogs pa'i rnam dpyod kyi/ /mchog sbyin stsol bar mdzad la=/ /tshe rabs kun du mgon po khyod nyid kyis/ /mngon sum rjes bzung mtha' yas 'gro kun gyi/ /som nyi'i dra ba gcod pa'i mthu ldan cing*/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gnas rnams mthar phyin shog /ces 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i bstod pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ / ༈ na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i zlos gar las/ / legs 'khrungs 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang zhes/ 'jig rten gsum na ches cher rab grags pa/ /rjes btsun phyag na padmos dge legs stsol/ /sku mchog gangs ri'i mdog ltar rab dkar zhing*/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'dzum ldan spyan dkyus ring*/ /rtsa phyag thal sbyar lhag mas shel 'phreng dang*/ /padma dkar po 'dzin la=/ /bung ba ltar nag ral ba'i thor cog bcings/ /sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spud/ /pad zla'i steng na mi phyed skyil krung gis/ /kus nas mdzes pa khyod la=/ /gsal rdzogs mtshan dang dpe byad dpal gyis spras/ /ral ba'i rtse na snang ba mtha' yas 'dzin/ kṛṣṇa sā ri'i pags pa'i rtags 'chang ba/ /drang srong chen po zhabs la=/ /nyin mtshan dus drug 'gro la rjes gzigs nas/ /gang la gang 'dul de la de mtshungs kyi/ /rnam 'phrul bgrang yas phyogs bcur spros pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa sgrub la=/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje ni/ /gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid nga yin zhes/ /zhal gyis 'ches pa ji bzhin 'gro ba'i don/ /mdzad pa'i khur chen 'khyer la=/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba mtha' dag 'dren pa la/ / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus gcig bsdus kyang*/ /mtshon par mi nus thugs rje ches dpa' ba/ /mtshan mchog don dang ldan la=/ /ris med phyogs kyi lus can thams cad dang*/

/khyad par sdug cing phongs pa'i 'gro rnams la/ /bka' drin lhag par che ba'i mdzad pa can/ /thugs rje'i gter chen khyod la=/ /gang dag yi ge drug pa 'di zlos pa/ /de dag 'gro drug sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /nges par nga yis myur du bsgral lo zhes/ /mi g.yo dam bca' brtan la=/ /de slad yig drug gus pas brjod byed pa/ /bdag la dgongs shig 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /zhal bzang mngon ston tshul shog bde ldan du/ /'dong zhes gsung gis dbugs dbyung mdzad du gsol/ /deng nas brtsams te tshe rabs kun tu yang*/ /dal 'byor rten rnyed nyid kyis rjes bzung nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don kun sgrub pa la/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dang mtshungs gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /rab 'byams bde gshegs thugs rje'i zlos gar ni/ /rab dkar rgyal ba'i sras su nyer shar ba/ /rab mchog mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang zhes/ /rab tu grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon gyis ma gos mtsho skyes zla ba'i steng*/ /hrī:yig dkar po 'od zer 'gro 'du las/ /legs 'khrungs gangs ri ltar dkar mnyam pa'i zhabs/ /bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lang tsho rab rgyas bcu drug na tshod can/ /bcu gcig zhal ldan rtsa ba'i zhal dkar zhing*/ /g.yas ljang g.yon pa dmar ba'i zhal gsum rim/ /dung g.yu byi ru'i mdog ltar mdzes la bstod/ /de steng dbus ljang g.yas dmar g.yon dkar zhal/ /mar gad pad rag zla ba ltar dkar zhing*/ /de steng dbus dmar g.yas dkar g.yos ljang zhal/ /byi ru kha ba g.yu ltar ljang la bstod/ /de steng khro zhal nag po spyan gsum la/ /skra brdzes mche ba gtsigs shing smra ra ser/ /steng zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas pa'i/ /zhal mang phyag stong spyan stong ldan la bstod/ /chos dbyings 'gyur med ye shes sku brnyes phyir/ /rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar/

/'gro drug mtho ris thar bar 'dren pa'i phyir/ /g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang 'phreng 'dzin la bstod/ /yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir/ /gsum pas mchog sbyin mdzad las bdud rtsi 'bab/ /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir/ /g.yas kyi bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin la bstod/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos mtshon pa'i phyir/ /g.yon gyi gnyis pas gser gyi padma bsnams/ /gdul bya'i nyon mongs dri ma 'khrud pa'i phyir/ /gsum pas ril pa spyi blugs 'dzin la bstod/ /thabs shes dag pa mthar thug brnyes pa'i phyir/ /g.yon gyi bzhi bas mda' dang gzhu bsnams shing*/ /lhag ma dgu brgya go gnyis phyag mthil na/ /stong phrag spyan gyis mdzes pa khyod la bstod/ /kṛṣṇa sā ri'i pags pa'i stong dkris dang*/ /sku smad dar ras bzang po'i sham thabs gsol/ /rin chen rgyan spras gser gyi ska rags bcings/ /'os phung 'phro ba'i dbus su bzhugs la bstod/ /phyag stong dag gi 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal stong*/ /spyan stong rnams kyis bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong*/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul ba'i rnam rol can/ /rje btsun spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ /mgon khyod bde gshegs 'phrin las gcig bsdus shing*/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mdzad pa kun sgrub ces/ /yang dang yang du bsngags la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma lus rgyas ba sras bcas thams cad kyi/ /thugs rjes gcig tu bsdus kyang mgon khyod kyi/ /brtse chen nyid la 'gran par bzod dka'i phyir/ /thugs rje chen por grags la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar bstod pas rab dkar dge des bdag /shi 'phos bde ldan zhing du skye ba dang*/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don kun sgrub pa la/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dang mtshungs par shog /ces pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du dad pas sbyar ro/

/bkra shis// ༈ 'jig rten mes po mgrin sngon sprin la zhon/ /pad dkar mig sogs srid pa gsum 'di na/ /cher grags dregs ldan kun gyi cod pan gyis/ /zhabs pad gus bsten rje btsun sgrol mar 'dud/ /mar gad ind+ra nī la 'dres pa'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis bcu drug lang tsho can/ /zhi 'dzum nyams ldan g.yas brkyang g.yon bskums kyis/ /pad zla'i steng nas mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas legs par brkyang ba'i mchog sbyin gyis/ /'gro ba'i re ba yid bzhin skong mdzad cing*/ /g.yon pas dkon mchog gsum mtshon skyabs sbyin gyis/ /phongs pa kun las sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po'i mtshon gyis g.yu yi mchod sdong bzhin/ /sna tshogs lha rdzas dar gyi na bzas klubs/ /ston gyi mkha' la rgyu skar 'phreng ba bzhin/ /rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab gsal mtshan dang dpe byad spras pa'i sku/ /yid 'phrog dri zas rgyud mangs 'bum gyi gsung*/ /zab yang mkhyen rtse'i rgya mtsho chen po'i thugs/ /lhun 'grub 'phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa kun/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid lha mo'i gzugs/ /dran pa yis kyang mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub ma lus stsol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dag sdug bsngal shugs kyis gdungs gyur pa/ /de dag kun gyi mgon skyabs nga nyid ces/ /zhal gyis 'ches bzhin thugs rje'i chu 'dzin las/ /phan bde'i char chen 'bebs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcig lhag bcu phrag zung gi phyag 'tshal dang*/ /rigs sngags chen mo tā re zlos tsam gyis/ /'jigs chen brgyad dang nad gdon kun sel zhing*/ /tshe dpal bsod nams ster la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phrin las nus mthu thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /rig pa'i lha mo sgrol ma'i tshogs rnams kyang*/ /rtag tu khyod zhabs bsten nas 'gro ba yi/ /sdug bsngal zhi bar brtson la phyag 'tshal lo/

/de ltar skyabs mchog khyod la gsol btab mthus/ /gnas skabs mi mthun 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*/ /mthun rkyen legs tshogs yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /mthar thug rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces seng ldeng nags sgrol la cung zad bstod pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas sbyar ba'o/ / ༈ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i zlos gar nyid/ /rab mdzes lha mo'i gzugs su nyer shar ba/ /srid pa gsum na rnam par rgyal ma zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med pad zla'i steng na khyed kyi sku/ /dad pa'i 'o mtshor shel gyi mchod sdong bzhin/ /yid 'phrog rin chen rgyan gyi spras gyur pa/ /gangs ri'i spo la rgyu skar do shal bzhin/ /dbus dang g.yas g.yon gyes pa'i zhal gsum ni/ /dung dang gser bzang ind+ra nī la bzhin/ / sgeg dang bzhi khro mdzes pa'i rnam gyur nyid/ /dad ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhin/ /pad rtsa ltar dkar zung bzhi'i phyag g.yas kyis/ /sna tshogs rdo rje tshe dpag mnga' mchog sbyin/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags ldan mi 'jigs ster/ /gzhu dang tshe yi bum pa bsnams pas mdzes/ /khyod sku sna tshogs dar gyis spras pa ni/ /ri bong can gyis 'ja' tshon gyon pa bzhin/ /yid 'phrog 'od phung phyogs bcur rab 'gyed pa/ /nyin mor byed las 'phro ba'i 'od zer bzhin/ /zhabs zung mi phyed skyil krung dang bcas te/ /rtag tu chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /rab 'byams zhing du bgrangs yas sprul pa'i tshogs/ /ngang ba'i mtsho nang zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rgyal sras phyag na padmo rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyig sngon stobs po che/ /'chi med bu rnams nyid sku'i g.yas g.yon dang*/ /phyogs bzhi ltar gnas khyod kyi 'phrin las sgrub/ /mkhyen pa shes bya kun la thogs pa med/ /brtse ba ris med 'gro ba yongs la khyab/

/nus pa thogs med 'jug pa'i 'phrin las can/ /lus can kun gyi skyabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar khyod zhabs gus pas bsten byas te/ /rtse gcig gsol gdab gzungs mchog bgrang ba las/ /phan yon rgyal bas ji skad bshad pa rnams/ /bslu med mngon du 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ khyad par blo rno tshe ring nad gdon bral/ /skye dran mchod 'os las sgrib 'dags pa dang*/ /shi 'phos bde ba can du skye ba sogs/ /thub pa'i gsung bzhin bdag la 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas sbyar ba'o// //༈ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshems kyi pad tshal las/ legs 'khrungs dbyangs can ngang mo thams cad dkar/ /lha yi lam nas rgyu skar rgyal pa bzhin/ /tshur spyon bdag gi yid mtshor rol bar mdzod/ /skyon bral chu skyes bsil zer rgyas pa'i steng*/ /mi phyed zhabs zung tsog bu'i 'gyings tshul can/ /phyag gnyis rgyud mangs spreng ba'i snyan 'gyur gyis/ /kun gyi yid 'phrog mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab dkar sku ni ston dus zla ba bzhin/ /rab snyan gsung ni dri za'i rgyud stong bzhin/ /rab gsal thugs ni nyin byed 'bum phrag bzhin/ /rab 'byams shes bya kun mkhyen rgyal ba bzhin/ /zla ba'i zhal la utpal rgyas pa'i spyan/ /sprin dkar tshems la glog dmar 'khyug pa'i ljags/ / mthon mthing ral pa'i thor cog bcings pa'i rtser/ /rgyu skar bdag po rtse dgas rol zhing rgyu/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mdzes sdug ma lus pa/ /gcig bsdus 'jo sgeg mdzes pa'i rnam gyur gyis/ /'chi med dbang mo tshogs kyi khengs 'phrog cing*/ /chags bral drang srong yid dbang nyid kyang 'gugs/ /bim pa ltar dmar zhal gyi sgo nyid dang*/ /pi wang bsgyur ba'i dbyangs kyis khams gsum na/ /ji snyed mchis pa'i sgra dang snyan ngag rigs/ /cig car sgrogs mkhas khyod min gzhan na su/ /khyod ni rgyal kun yum du gyur lags kyang*/

/bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin gzhon nu'i bzhin/ /sgra tshad sdeb sbyor snyan tshig smra ba la/ /srid gsum 'di na gzhan gyi 'gran zlas dben/ /rab mdzes lta bas mi ngoms dbyangs can ma/ /ma ltar brtse ldan khyod la gus bstod tshe/ /tshe 'dir snyan ngag smra la bdag gi ngag /ngag dbang lha mo khyod dang mtshungs gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas sbyar ba'o// //madgalaṃ// //rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus nas/ rab brjid lha mo'i gzugs su rnam rol ba/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gtsug tor gdugs dkar zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mdzes ldan chu skyes rgyas pa'i lte ba la/ /cha shas yongs rdzogs rgyu skar bdag po'i steng*/ /dri med shel gyi mchod sdong lta bu'i sku/ /brkyangs bskums tshul gyis bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sprul ba'i dbu stong phyag zhabs stong phrag ldan/ /bye ba rgya phrag stong gi spyan mnga' zhing*/ /sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun la dbang mdzad ma/ /mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can la 'dud/ /zhal stong sgeg cing dpa' ba'i nyams ldan pa'i/ /rtsa zhal nyis brgya dung ltar rab tu dkar/ /'jigs rung rgod pa'i nyams ldan g.yas kyi zhal/ /nyis brgya gser gyi mdog ltar ser la 'dud/ /gshe dang shin tu rngams pa'i nyams ldan gyi/ /rgyab zhal nyis brgya byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar/ /snying rje zhi ba'i nyams ldan g.yon gyi zhal/ /nyis brgya mthing gi mdor ltar sngo la 'dud/ /ngo mtshar ba dang drag po'i nyams ldan gyi/ /steng zhal nyis brgya mar gad mdog ltar ljang*/ /stong phrag zhal rer spyan gsum dang ldan cing*/ /spyi gtsug khro ba'i rdo rjes mtshan la 'dud/ /rgyal ba gdung bdun bde gshegs bcu la sogs/ /sangs rgyas phye ba phrag bdun cod pan 'dzin/ /g.yas g.yon dang pos 'khor lo skyabs sbyin dang*/ /mda' gdugs yu ba thugs kar 'dzin la 'dud/

/g.yas g.yon lhag ma dgu bcu rtsa brgyad na/ /'khor lo mda' 'dzin g.yas kyi lhag ma ni/ /bzhi brgyas rim bzhin rdo rje ri po che/ /padma sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin la 'dud/ /g.yon gyi lhag ma bzhi brgyas rim pa bzhin/ /gzhu dang ral gri zhags pa lcags kyu rnams/ /brgya phrag re re 'dzin cing dbu rgyan sogs/ /rin chen dar gyi nam bzas mdzes la 'dud/ /zhabs g.yas lnga brgya brkyangs pas rgyal sogs kyi/ /'jigs pa chen po thams cad gnon mdzad cing*/ /g.yon pa lnga brgya bskums pas mdangs 'phrog sogs/ /gdon rigs thams cad 'joms par mdzad la 'dud/ /sku yi cha na zur gyis lta ba dang*/ /cher bgrang ba dang glog ltar 'gyu ba dang*/ /drag tu gzir sogs bye ba brgya stong gi /grangs ldan spyan gyis spras pa khyod la 'dud/ / sgeg cing dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba sogs/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /rdo rje'i me 'od bskal ba'i me lta bur/ /rab 'bar 'phro ba'i dbus na bzhugs la 'dud/ /gang gi zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bzhi/ /thogs med sgrub mdzad mthu rtsal stobs ldan pa'i/ /gzhan gyi mi thub drag shul che la sogs/ /nyer gnyis phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas la 'dud/ /tshangs dang brgya byin la sogs srid gsum gyi/ /dregs pa'i gtso bo sde brgyad thams cad dang*/ /legs ldan drag po la sogs mched gsum gyis/ /zhabs bsten 'phrin las sgrub par mdzad la 'dud/ /de slad bcom ldan 'das ma khyod nyid la/ / mchod cing bstod pas rgyal po'i 'jigs pa sogs/ /'jigs chen kun dang mngal dang sha khrag sogs/ /za ba'i gdon 'gegs rigs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /gang gis ngan sngags sgo nas bdag cag gi /bde legs 'phrog pa'i rig sngags sbyor ba kun/ /ral gris gcod dang 'bar ba'i phur bu yis/ / gdab cing srung dang skyob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /nyin gcig la sogs rims nad sna tshogs dang*/ /gdon gyis bskyed dang 'byung ba 'khrugs sogs kyi/

/phyi nang nad gdon bar chad thams cad kyang*/ /khyod zhabs dran pa tsam gyis zhi bar mdzod/ /mdor na bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas la/ /bdag cag gus pas skyabs song gsol btab pas/ /'gal rkyen mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*/ /mthun rkyen 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyis dad pas sbyar ro// //madgalaṃ// ༈ ma lus rgyal ba'i mthu stobs nus pa'i tshogs/ /dpal ldan khro bo'i dbang po'i bskur bstan pa/ /gsang sngags rig sngags 'chang rnams kun gyi rje/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /rgyal kun thugs kyi rang bzhin hūṃ yig las/ /legs 'khrungs dbang sngon brtsegs pa'i lhun po bzhin/ /rab brjid bgyings pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs la bstod/ /gtum drag spom zhing thung la grim pa'i sku/ / phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga 'bar/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phyar nas g.yon pa yis/ /gser gyi dril bu dkur bsten 'dzin la bstod/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad nas lta/ /dbu skra gyen brjes khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus/ /rin chen sprul dang stag sham smad dkris shing*/ / brkyangs bskums me dpung dbus na bzhugs la bstod/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /mtha' dag mngon gyur ji bzhin 'dzin mdzad cing*/ /gsang sngags bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur bas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso bor gyur la bstod/ /gang tshe bde gshegs kun gyi mgon po khyod/ /gsang sngags rig sngags mthu stobs bdag po ru/ /dbang bskur dus la babs tshe rgyal kun gyis/ /cig car byin gyis brlabs par gyur la bstod/ /de tshe rgyal ba kun gyis so so nas/ /ye shes 'od dang bdud rtsis dbang bskur zhing*/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo rdo rje mchog /khyod kyi phyag tu gtad par gyur la bstod/

/de nas khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa rnams/ /sngar las 'bum 'gyur 'phel te khyed kyi thugs/ /gsang ba'i mdzod gyur thu stobs nus pa'i dpung*/ /kun gyis 'gran zla med par gyur la bstod/ /de phyir rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa kun/ /nyid la gtad nas srung bar zhal bzhes pas/ /bstan srung kun gyi gtso bor gyur la bstod/ /srid pa gsum na mthu chen dregs ldan pa'i/ /lha klu lha min gza' bdud rgyu skar dang*/ /gshin rje srin po gnod sbyin 'byung po sogs/ /kun gyis khyod zhabs bsten par gyur la bstod/ /de slad 'jig rten dregs pa sde brgyad la/ /khyed kyi 'khor du ma gyur yong min cing*/ /dus babs 'dul bar mi nus srid min pas/ /snang srid kun gyi gtso bor gyur la bstod/ /mthu chen khyod la bstod cing gsol btab mthus/ /bdag gi 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /mthun rkyen bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang gegs med thob gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang shākya'i btsun pa bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ro/ /maṅga laṃ/ / ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje 'phrin las rnams/ /gcig bsdus khro rgyal kun gyi rjer gyur pa/ /gsang bsngags rigs bsngags mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rgyal bas khyod sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin du/ /byin gyis brlabs tshe rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi/ /rig sngags chen mo nyid kyis gsungs pa yis/ /mtha' dag 'gro la phan par mdzad la bstod/ /gsang bdag sku yi rnam 'gyur ches mang yang*/ /gtso bo rnam brgyad thugs kyi sprul ba mchog /bcom ldan rdo rje rnam pa 'joms pa zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sna tshogs pad ma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /mar gad ri dbang nyin byed 'bum 'khyud lta'i/

/rab mdzes sku ni khro 'dzum nyams kyis brjid/ /skyil krung 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs la bstod/ /phyag g.yas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi/ /sna tshogs rdo rje thugs dkar gsor ba'i tshul/ /g.yon pas rig sngags stong nyid sgra sgrogs pa'i/ /las kyi dril bu dkur bsten 'dzin la bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ ma rungs 'dul phyir grangs med sprul pa'i tshogs/ /phyogs bcur spros nas ma lus gdon bgegs rigs/ /tshar gcod 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub la bstod/ /mi chod mi shig bden pa sra sogs dang*/ /sdig byang sdug bsngal thams cad med pa sogs/ /khyod gzungs phan yon rgyal ba'i gsungs de dag / bdag gis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar bstod cing gsol bas mgon khyod kyis/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas la gnod pa yi/ / nad gdon bar chad nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang*/ /mthun rkyen 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis bris so/ / ༈ bde ldan zhing gtso snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ /'jig rten gsum mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir khro bo'i dbang bo'i skur/ /mngon bstan khro rgyal rta mgrin zhabs la 'dud/ /ri las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /hrīḥyig dmar po 'phro 'du las 'khrungs pa'i/ /rab dmar pad rāg lhun po lta bu'i sku/ /brkyangs bkums stabs kyi bzhugs pa khyod la 'dud/ /dmar ljang rab tu dkar ba'i zhal gsum ni/ /byi ru mar gang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /rta mgo ljang nag rta skad 'tsher ba'i sgra/ /stong phrag rnga gsang dus gcig sgrogs pa bzhin/ /rngams pa'i zhal gdangs mche ba rab gtsigs pa/ /srid gsum gdon bgegs cig car za ba bzhin/ /phyag drug mi bzad mtshon cha gdengs pa ni/ khams gsum 'byung po thal bar rlog pa bzhin/ /dbu skra gyen brjes zhal rer spyan gsum ldan/

/thod bskam dbu rgyan thod rlon do shal 'phyang*/ /yan lag sprul bcings stag pags sham thabs can/ /gar dgu nyams dang ldan pa khyod la bstod/ /sku yi cha dang ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /dus mtha'i 'od dpung 'phro dang lhan cig tu/ /sna tshogs mtshon cha 'dzin pa'i khro chung tshogs/ /grangs med spro bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro rgyal khyod la bstod pas bdag cag la/ /gnod pa'i gza' dang rgyal po klu btsan sogs/ /gdon bgegs rigs rnams ma lus zhi ba dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ro/ / ༈ rnam par snang mdzad ye shes sgyu ma'i gar/ ma lus bgegs dpung 'joms phyir khros pa'i sku/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pas g.yo ba mi mnga' ba'i/ /rje btsun mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon bral chu skyes 'dab ma rgyas pa'i dbus/ /raṃ yig las skyes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po'i gdan la rab brjid pa'i/ /brkyangs bskums stabs kyi bzhugs la=/ /ind+ra nī la'i mdangs ltar rab sngo zhing*/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis 'bar ba'i ral gri dang*/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad nas bdud kyi dpung*/ /kun nas 'joms pa khyod la=/ /rab 'bar dbu skra khams ser gyen du brjes/ /dmar zlum spyan gsum sdang mig tshul gyis bgrad/ /zhal gdangs khro nyer dpral ba'i dbyings su bsdus/ /rin chen dar gyis brgyan la=/ /ba spu'i rtse nas ye shes me chen dang*/ /grangs med sprul pa phyogs bcur rab tu 'phro/ /mthu chen stobs kyis bgegs tshogs ma lus pa/ /rnam par 'jig par mdzad la=/ /thugs mchog zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir drag tu khros pa'i sku/ /'jig pa'i nyams ldan dpa' ba'i rtags 'chang ba/ /khro rgyal dbang bo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar rtse gcig khyod la gsol btab pas/ /'gal rkyen nad gdon nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*/

/mthun rkyen tshe dpal bsod nams shes rab sogs/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o/ /de lta bu'i gsol 'debs dang bstod pa 'di rnams snga phyir brtsams pa yin yang*/ phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas bar du brko ba'i tshe bar gyi yi ge pa ni skar rtsis dang snyan ngag sogs kyi rig gnas la blo gros rgyas pa'i khya'o lung dka' bcu pa blo bzang dbang phyug go ///madgalaṃ// //
